(Japanese: '''VSラッタ''' ''VS {{tt|Ratta|Raticate}}'') is the 82nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 42nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The chapter begins with [[Lance]] showing off his power of healing to {{adv|Yellow}} when he cures {{p|Aerodactyl}}'s damage. Yellow then realizes that he shares the same powers as her, realizing why {{adv|Green}} set her on this journey. Yellow then tells {{adv|Mewtwo}}, who is inside the [[Master Ball]], that there is a legend of every time once a few years, a person is born in [[Viridian Forest]] with the power of reading Pokémon minds and healing. Then she becomes ready to give up due to the enormous difference of power between them, but Mewtwo gives her a change of opinion and sends her party towards Lance. Lance escapes into the volcano of [[Cerise Island]] and Yellow follows him. Upon arriving, Lance tells her that he uses the power of his dragons to warm up the volcano, saying that it will be the scenario for their final battle. Suddenly a giant {{TP|Lance|Dragonite}} appears and uses its {{m|Strength}} to break the ground near Yellow, releasing lava everywhere and causing the volcano to erupt. Yellow then remarks the training section Blaine had before meeting up with her, and Blue's words, to realize the reason of that kind of training. She orders {{p|Doduo}} to use {{m|Peck}} and [[Ratty]] to use {{m|Super Fang}} on the Dragonite, but with no avail as it throws both aside. She tries again with {{p|Graveler}}'s {{m|Take Down}}, {{p|Omanyte}}'s {{m|Water Gun}}, and [[Kitty]]'s {{m|String Shot}}, but again they are defeated. Yellow pleads to Lance to stop his awful plan, saying that both Pokémon and human are being hurt in this war, but he ignores her. She says that he shouldn't use his powers that way, remembering {{adv|Red}}'s words. Lance orders Dragonite to use {{m|Fire Blast}} on her, which sends her flying into a boulder. ==Major events== * {{Adv|Yellow}} realizes the reason she was chosen to take on the [[Elite Four]] is because she shares the same powers as [[Lance]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Adv|Red}} (flashback) * {{Adv|Blue}} (flashback) * {{Adv|Green}} (flashback) * {{Adv|Yellow}} * [[Blaine]] (flashback) * [[Lance]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Raticate}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Doduo}} ([[Dody]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Graveler}} (Gravvy; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Omanyte}} ([[Omny]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Mewtwo}} ({{adv|Mewtwo|Blaine's}}) * {{p|Dragonair}} ([[Lance]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Dragonite}} ({{OP|Lance|Dragonite}}) * {{p|Aerodactyl}} ([[Lance]]'s) * {{p|Gyarados}} ({{OP|Lance|Gyarados}}) * {{p|Arcanine}} ([[Evan]]'s) * {{p|Mankey}} (multiple; flashback) * {{p|Farfetch'd}} (flashback) ==Trivia== * This chapter is included in [[The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow]]. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 拉達|VS Raticate}} (Taiwan)
